response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_matches, AVG(g.match_count - t.avg_match_count) AS average_excess_matches FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE g.match_count > t.avg_match_count;

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate has an undefined ratio, so it is excluded from ratio averages while its matched row remains in the match count.
